2609.19942.title: Intrinsic Sequence-Likelihood Confidence in Retrieval-Dominated Extractive QA: Two Pre-Specified Negatives, and What They Do and Do Not Attribute
2609.19942.paper_summary: In extractive document question answering whose questions were generated from the passages that contain their answers -- so that retrieval recovers 92-99.8% of what any mode combination could reach, whatever its absolute accuracy -- confidence-driven mechanisms have little to gain. Fine-tuning an open language model on a specialized domain corpus yields a model whose own confidence is a tempting control signal: it could decide which queries warrant further adaptation, and which answers to trust. We evaluate both uses under criteria fixed before the runs were executed, across four 7-9B model families whose adaptation moved closed-book F1 by at most +0.03, and both fail: a distillation trigger on all four families, under its pre-specified three-step transfer budget, and a routing-and-abstention policy in its single-model pilot. Retrieval alone recovers 92-99.8% of best-case combined accuracy under every correctness criterion we test, leaving routers no meaningful gain. The sequence-likelihood signal is insufficient relative to that mode -- area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.65-0.81 under the registered criterion -- before adaptation as well as after, unchanged by scalar recalibration and not consistently improved by token-level temperature rescaling. And the finer diagnostics depend on the correctness criterion and on answer length; on the three adapted combinations where we could test it, selector ablations show no statistically detectable downstream benefit from the confidence term on any seed; on Gemma, removing it changes the selector from failing to passing both registered criteria. The usable product is a set of pre-specified negatives with their dependencies made explicit.
2609.19942.paper_summary_zh: 在提取式文檔問答中，問題是從包含其答案的段落中生成的——因此檢索能夠恢復92-99.8%的任何模式組合所能達到的結果，無論其絕對準確性如何——基於信心的機制幾乎沒有收益。對專門領域語料庫進行開放語言模型的微調，產生了一個自身信心成為誘人控制信號的模型：它可以決定哪些查詢值得進一步調整，哪些答案值得信賴。我們在運行之前固定的標準下評估了這兩種用途，涵蓋了四個7-9B模型系列，其適應使得閉卷F1最多提高了+0.03，但兩者均失敗：在其預先指定的三步轉移預算下，對所有四個系列的蒸餾觸發，以及在其單模型試點中的路由和放棄政策。僅僅依賴檢索在我們測試的每個正確性標準下恢復了92-99.8%的最佳情況下的綜合準確性，這使得路由器沒有任何有意義的收益。相對於該模式，序列似然信號不足——在註冊標準下，接收器操作特徵曲線下的面積為0.65-0.81——在適應之前和之後都沒有改變，且未通過標量重新校準一致改善，並且未通過標記級別的溫度重新縮放一致改善。而更細緻的診斷依賴於正確性標準和答案長度；在我們能夠測試的三個適應組合中，選擇器消融顯示在任何種子上，信心項對下游沒有統計上可檢測的益處；在Gemma上，去除它使選擇器從未通過變為通過兩個註冊標準。可用的產品是一組預先指定的負樣本，其依賴關係被明確化。
